title: unified-rollouts: proactive shadow + A/B autorollback workflows with stability guards
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: Improve rollout safety and visibility by adding proactive shadow probing and automated A/B autorollback workflows tied to multi-metric stability guards. This change unifies the shadow probing logic used by staged canaries and enables proactive detection of regressions in shadow traffic before shifting live traffic. It also introduces an A/B autorollback controller that evaluates live traffic metrics alongside shadow probes and executes automated rollback when configured thresholds are exceeded. Key goals: 1) catch regressions earlier using shadow probes, 2) provide policy-driven autorollback for A/B experiments, 3) surface richer observability and traceability for rollout decisions. This PR includes: rollout controller enhancements, new rollout policy CRD fields, proactive shadow probing engine, A/B autorollback controller, CLI/console flags for enabling policies, unit and e2e tests, and documentation updates. Rollout plan: staged rollout to canary clusters with feature flag disabled by default; enable in staging and run smoke e2e; then enable in production for a subset of customers behind a feature flag. Related: ENG-4621 (proactive shadowing), ENG-4680 (autorollback policies), SUP-9087 (support escalation: incident postmortem influence).

release_notes: - Added proactive shadow probing to detect regressions in shadow traffic before routing live traffic. - Introduced A/B autorollback controller with multi-metric policies and hysteresis to reduce flapping. - New rollout policy CRD fields for probe sampling, stability windows, and metric thresholds. - Console UI to configure rollout policies and feature flags. - Added unit and e2e tests for new components.
testing_and_validation: Unit tests: added coverage for probe scheduling, aggregation, and rollback decision logic. E2E: deterministic probe harness exercising a staged canary + shadow scenario; CI re-run stabilized flakes. Manual validation: deployed to internal staging, ran synthetic traffic profiles that triggered probe alerts and validated safe rollback path. Metrics validated: latency P99, error-rate, and success-rate dimensions used in multi-metric policy. Observability: events emitted for probe start/complete/eval and rollback decisions. Logs: structured events include rollout_id, probe_id, and decision_reason.
notes_for_releasers: Feature gated behind rollout.featureProactiveShadow and rollout.featureABAutorollback helm flags (default: false). To enable in a cluster: set values.rollout.featureProactiveShadow=true and values.rollout.featureABAutorollback=true and restart controller. Enable gradual activation via console per-namespace policy. Follow runbook in docs/rollouts/autorollback-policy.md for emergency disable.

authors_notes: This PR focuses on safety and observability. Performance impact is minimal: probe sampling uses existing shadow path and aggregated metrics are computed offline by the controller to avoid adding latency. On large clusters, probe sampling rate should be tuned to avoid extra cost.
